listingPermission: Listing is its own permission. If these credentials are scoped to particular {nouns} rather than the whole account, name those on the connection and it will read them without asking for the list.
signedInChoose: Signed in to {label}. Choose the {noun} on the connection.
connectedNone: Connected to {where}. This account has no {nouns} yet.
storageGone: That storage account is no longer set up.
accountGone: That cloud account is no longer set up.
noFileStorage: {vendorLabel} has no file storage this app can read.
noLogService: {vendorLabel} has no log service this app can read.
setRegion: Set a region first: {label} lists its {nouns} one region at a time.
connectedRegionNone: Connected to {label} in {region}. Nothing there yet.
whatAws: Files in S3, log events in CloudWatch.
whatAzure: Files in Blob Storage, log events in Azure Monitor.
whatGcp: Files in Cloud Storage, log events in Cloud Logging.
whatS3Compat: Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, Ceph, or anything else that speaks the S3 API.
importsS3Compat: your AWS CLI config, where an S3-compatible key is usually kept
awsSso: Signed in through SSO. It works while your session lasts, and a scheduled flow stops when it expires until you sign in again.
awsAssume: Assumes a role. It works wherever the profile it is based on does.
awsCommand: Runs a command of yours to fetch credentials. It works here as long as that command does.
awsWebIdentity: Uses a web identity token file.
awsNoCreds: This profile names no credentials of its own, so it may rely on something else on this computer.
